name: When is shower removal the right call instead of just repairing the shower?
description: Remove the shower when leaks, mold, cracks, or a failing pan suggest the damage is bigger than a surface repair.

mainEntity.name: When is shower removal the right call instead of just repairing the shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you suspect leaks, soft walls, mold, cracked tile, or a failing shower pan, remove the shower sooner rather than later. Hidden water damage can spread behind the walls and turn a simple removal into a larger restoration job.
